{{Top|leg}}
An '''aerial sensor''' was a device used to detect and track airborne or atmospheric vehicles. The [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] could be set up at an airfield or [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], or built into a [[Hovercraft|ground-effect]] or [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle.
